name: Longbough Arrows
description: Elven-crafted arrows with Longbough-matched shafts, fletched with standard bird feathers — the canonical ammunition elven longbowmen pair with their Longbough bows.
narrative_effects: Standard longbow ammunition with the specific balance Longbough draws favor.
Minor Vaelmere export; realm archers who have acquired the pairing rarely give it up.
